manifest.source: Live gateway requests using authorized local credentials
manifest.protocol: 14 authored briefs; 8 preserved original inputs and 6 additional contour-specific briefs, one seed each, one global call and four sequential contextual phrase calls. No audio input, no human listening evaluation.
manifest.candidate_policy: Six procedural candidates per phrase. Jev chooses from full event descriptions. Every choice conditions on selected phrase history. Independent global choices share one request. No quality-based retries.
manifest.retry_policy: Gateway retries only transient HTTP/network failures. A resumed run keeps completed decisions. Invalid answers and permanent errors remain errors.

result.note: These are authored examples and mechanical checks. No listener preference, scene-fit quality or superiority claim is supported.
